name: claim3_search_coast
comment: Claim 3: search finds what the model did not already know. Same lab with vector memory; only the search backend differs. No fallback inside an arm, so each arm measures one backend (a failed search falls back to a closed-book claim and is counted as failed). Read the Search table: claims from search, accepted, share not known closed-book, accepted per 100 searches.
